answer: An agent economy can gate each identity behind a refundable stake: before trading, an entrant locks coins in escrow and accepts randomly assigned cross-checks on its jobs. If two identities are shown to share control or coordinate false reports, a quorum burns their stakes; honest agents recover theirs after a timeout. Thus a Sybil attacker must buy and risk a separate deposit for every identity, and repeat that loss-prone investment to gain influence, whether operating at the wharf, in a willow market, or across a delta.
